concepts.gloss_en: Shaddai (the divine name 'the Almighty' / El Shaddai)

reason_for_human: All 8 occurrences refer to the divine name Shaddai — repeatedly glossed in-text as 'He said to His world Enough (dai)' and 'there is enough in My Godliness for every creature,' and tied to brit, teshuvah, tzimtzum, and Metatron. The one sin-vocalized proof (שָׂדַי, occ:1306) is an exegetical/mystical reading of the SAME divine name (the translator even renders it 'Sadai (Shaddai)'), not the separate word 'field' — so it is a spelling/reading variant, not a true homograph. Single concept.
